title: The Babe House! - 2 miles to Broadway/Sleeps 12!
description:
Thank you for visiting "The Babe House" listing!💗

This home is ***NEWLY REDECORATED*** as of August 2024! This is the PERFECT home for your bachelorette/girls trip to Nashville! Equipped with 6 beds, 4 bedrooms, 3 bath, BEAUTIFUL flower wall photo opp, and makeup/getting ready areas! This beautiful pink home is in a PRIME LOCATION, only 2 miles from Broadway (4 min Uber), right next to the Parthenon, less than 1 mile from Vandy, and near Belmont!..Doesn't get any better! :)

The space
REASONS TO BOOK THIS HOME:
* IT'S PINK!!! :)💗
*2 miles to the Honky Tonks on Broadway (4 min Uber)
*2.5 miles to Bridgestone Arena
*3 miles to the Titan's Stadium
*AMAZING Flower Wall/Photo Opp at the home!
*Makeup/getting ready stations!
*No Check-Out "To-Do's"!!!🎉
*4 Bedroom, 3 Full Bath, 6 Beds!
*Gas Fireplace
*Top of the line pillow top mattresses
*Comfortable bedding
*Luxury linens
*Fully stocked kitchen!
*2 Washers and 2 Dryers
*Each bedroom has its own 55 inch 4K Samsung flat screen TV
*Living Room has a 65 inch Samsung 4K TV with a BOSE soundbar for everyone to enjoy
*Centrally located in West End Park behind the West End Ave Maggiano's
*Next to the Parthenon
*Walking distance to restaurants, the park, or a Vandy game! 
*You're right near the interstate so you can get anywhere quickly!
*Partnered with Bach Babes for all your decorating needs! 
*(Note: Bedroom w/ trendy garage door balcony is on the 2nd floor and is NOT the garage on 1st floor)

BEDROOM LAYOUT:
1st Floor: Living/Dining/Kitchen, Full Bathroom, Private Garage
2nd Floor: Bonus Room (2Queens), Front Bedroom (1Queen) with Porch, Middle Bedroom (1King), Full Bathroom, Laundry Room
3rd Floor: Master Bedroom (2Queens), Full En Suite Bathroom
***TOTAL OF 6 BEDS - 1 King & 5 Queens***

This luxe vacation rental is one of five gorgeous townhouses together- in a PRIME LOCATION, only one street over from West End Avenue, which turns into Broadway/Downtown! These are upscale, designed to the 9's homes laid out to comfortably sleep 12 people in 4 magnificent bedrooms! Our favorite part of the house is the open floor plan, which is perfect for gathering, stunning outdoor space, and the soaring ceilings!

***The 2nd floor of the home offers a sleek, modern garage door - which are all the rage in new homes - easily transforming this room into fresh, bright indoor/outdoor balcony space to enjoy!***

✅ NO CHECK OUT TO-DO'S!! ✅
We are thrilled to have our guests stay with us on their vacation! We want our guests to spend their vacation relaxing and not worry about tasks to do early in the morning prior to driving home or hurrying to the airport! All we ask is that you lock the doors on the way out and our crew takes care of everything! :)

🏠 Spacious & Perfect for Groups! 🏠
Looking for extra room? This charming townhome is part of a row of six, making it ideal for large groups to stay together in comfort. Whether it’s a work retreat, family reunion, or wedding celebration, everyone can have a blast under one roof! 
If this particular unit is unavailable or if you need up to six adjoining townhomes for your group, don’t hesitate to reach out. We’d love to help accommodate your needs – just send us a message to explore our other listings!
https://www.airbnb.com/users/show/22933775

Nashville STR Permit: two-zero-one-six-zero-five-two-nine-five-four

Guest access
You will have access to the entire home and a 1 car garage!
